title: ignis POST /api/v1/calculate/:code Request Schema
description: Optional JSON body for POST /api/v1/calculate/:code. Every field overrides the corresponding TABULA record default for the variant named in the path; omit any field to keep the TABULA value. An empty object {} or an empty body is valid and uses TABULA defaults throughout.

A_ref.description: Overrides the reference floor area (A_C_Ref_Input), m².

HeatingDays.description: Overrides the heating season length, days.

Theta_e.description: Overrides the external design temperature, °C. May be negative.

delta_U_ThermalBridging_Original.description: Overrides the thermal-bridging U-value delta for the original (unrefurbished) envelope, W/m²K.

delta_U_ThermalBridging_Refurbished.description: Overrides the thermal-bridging U-value delta for the refurbished envelope, W/m²K.

h_room.description: Overrides the archetype's assumed room height, m. Feeds the ventilation heat transfer coefficient directly.

n_Storey.description: Overrides the assumed storey count. Feeds the envelope-area estimation path; has less effect once real surfaces are also given.

n_air_infiltration.description: Overrides the infiltration air change rate, 1/h.

n_air_use.description: Overrides the use-related air change rate, 1/h.

c_m.description: Overrides the effective heat capacity, J/K.

surfaces.description: Replaces TABULA's fixed 2-3 slots per element category with an arbitrary list of individual physical surfaces. Surfaces are grouped by type and collapsed into an area-weighted equivalent before the pipeline runs. Any category with no surfaces given keeps its TABULA default.

id.description: Caller-assigned identifier for this surface, used only in error messages.

type.description: Element category this surface belongs to.

azimuth.description: Degrees, 0=N/90=E/180=S/270=W. Windows only; defaults to South (180) if omitted.

tilt.description: Degrees; windows only. Near 0 buckets the window as horizontal (skylight).
